This page collects my main engineering, research and development work. The portfolio is organized
as a technical record: **problem → design → implementation → testing → results / lessons learned**.

# MASTER'S RESEARCH — LIVER VIABILITY & ICG-NIR

My Master's thesis focuses on developing an ex vivo liver perfusion platform and using ICG-NIR
kinetics to investigate quantitative indicators of liver function and viability.

<div class="image-slot large">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO GENERAL DEL PROYECTO DE TESIS
    <small>Plataforma completa de perfusión con hígado, bomba, sensores, oxigenador y computador de adquisición</small>
  </div>
</div>

## Objective 1 — Ex Vivo Perfusion Platform

Build a stable and reproducible experimental platform capable of maintaining rat livers under
controlled physiological conditions.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["Reservoir"] --> B["Peristaltic Pump"]
    B --> C["Pulse Damper"]
    C --> D["Flow Sensor"]
    D --> E["Oxygenator"]
    E --> F["Bubble Trap"]
    F --> G["Liver"]
    G --> H["Return"]
```

</div>

# ROBOTICS & REHABILITATION

## Ciervo UC — CYBATHLON 2024

I participated in CYBATHLON 2024 in Zürich as **Electrical Area Leader** of Ciervo UC. The project
involved developing a robotic transfemoral prosthesis for functional competition tasks.

- Electrical system design.
- Electronic prototyping and manufacturing.

- Coordination between electronics, control and mechanics.
- Troubleshooting under real operational constraints.

# EMBEDDED SYSTEMS & FPGA

## FPGA Upgrade — Universal Testing Machine

Development of an FPGA-based processing board for a universal mechanical testing machine.

The system processes signals associated with force, displacement, deformation and speed using
**Zybo Z10, Vivado and VHDL**.

# Engineering approach {.toc-ignore}

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["Understand problem"] --> B["Identify measurable variables"]
    B --> C["Review literature / existing systems"]
    C --> D["Define requirements"]
    D --> E["Prototype"]
    E --> F["Measure"]
    F --> G["Compare"]
    G --> H["Redesign"]
    H --> I["Validate"]
    I --> J["Integrate & document"]
```
